09 / ChatGPT India Campaign · Research Coordinator

I went looking for stories. I found people.

Working as a Research Coordinator with CREATE Media on a campaign for ChatGPT India has been one of the most meaningful experiences of my career. My job was to find remarkable people across India who were using ChatGPT to make a real difference in their lives. But finding a story was just the beginning. I scouted people, reached out, listened to their experiences, conducted meetings, documented their journeys, prepared research dossiers, and coordinated with the central team. Once a story moved forward, I helped assign creators and manage logistics until it was ready to go live. The three reels here started as stories I discovered and helped bring to life. Sometimes, the most meaningful thing you can do is help someone else's story be heard.
